title: UK energy company Drax partners with Brookfield and neocloud Radiant to develop an AI data center in North Yorkshire, targeting 100MW of capacity by Q1 2028 (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
summary: Kai Nicol-Schwarz / CNBC: UK energy company Drax partners with Brookfield and neocloud Radiant to develop an AI data center in North Yorkshire, targeting 100MW of capacity by Q1 2028 — Brookfield is targeting a massive artificial intelligence data center in the north of England, as Europe scrambles to develop infrastructure …
